name: Epic Con Moscow
blurb: A fantasy, film and video-game festival in Moscow with a cosplay contest, exhibits and interactive zones; sister event to Epic Con St. Petersburg.
notes: Re-checked epicconrussia.ru fresh (--fresh) plus its /tickets/ page and a web search (Epic Con Москва 2027 даты): still the same 'Успейте оформить билет на EPIC CON 2027 по цене предпродажи! Скоро старт продаж билетов!' (hurry to get your EPIC CON 2027 ticket at presale price, sales starting soon) banner with no specific dates anywhere, and no third-party source names one either - confirming a 2027 edition is planned but unannounced, so editions stays empty. Added 'last': the Moscow edition for 2026 ran July 4-5, 2026 (per the site's own title/text) at 'Main Stage', ul. Sharikopodshipnikovskaya 13s33, Moscow (per the site's own Contacts page) - already over before this window starts (2026-10-05). No dedicated guest/lineup page was found in the site nav (Home/Map/Schedule/Cosplay/Partners/Contacts/Tickets), so guests were not researched for this (currently edition-less) entry. Re-check once 2027 dates go live.
